quarterly_data.quarter: Amgen press release: IMDELLTRA IN COMBINATION WITH IMFINZI DEMONSTRATED LANDMARK (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Phase 3 DeLLphi-305 (five hundred and sixty-three patients, randomized 1:1; sponsored by Amgen with partial funding and durvalumab provided by AstraZeneca) met its primary endpoint at a pre-specified interim analysis: IMDELLTRA (tarlatamab-dlle) plus durvalumab as first-line maintenance in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer delivered a statistically significant and clinically meaningful overall survival improvement versus durvalumab alone, plus significant PFS and ORR improvements, with no new safety signals; the study used 1 to 2 hours of post-infusion monitoring (6 to 8 hours in certain regions including Europe). Amgen says it is the first Phase 3 study including a BiTE therapy to show an OS benefit in this setting and will present detailed data and share them with regulators.
quarterly_data.figure: OS primary endpoint met at a pre-specified interim analysis
